returnInterest.note: It's a nice country, but it doesn't come to mind when I think about future trips.

description.intro: Austria is a Central European country known for its alpine landscapes, historic cities, and strong cultural traditions. During my visit, I appreciated the mountain scenery, infrastructure, and local food and drink culture. While I enjoyed my time there, it is not a destination I currently feel a strong urge to revisit.
standouts: The country has a rich history.
The infrastructure was generally very good.
I thought the beer was excellent.
The summer weather felt very comfortable.
culturalNotes: People appeared to be proud of their country and culture.
personalNotes: In my experience, I did not always find people particularly welcoming toward tourists.

paymentNotes: Both cards and cash are generally accepted.
transportNotes: Austria has a good train network for traveling around the country.
Train journeys through mountainous regions can be quite slow because trains often travel at reduced speeds (around 60km/h).
Major cities have good tram systems.
I found the bus networks in cities to be quite good.
languageNotes: Austrian German is the main language.

notes: The weather is generally comfortable and neither too hot nor too cold.

foodNotes: I found the bakeries particularly good.
Beer culture is strong throughout the country.
Many places serve their own local beer.
I would definitely recommend trying a Wiener Schnitzel while in Austria, although I personally would not make a trip to the country just for that dish.
